BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_LOOPBACK.desc: Source a BMP session from an existing loopback

BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_LOOPBACK_.desc: Reject a BMP source interface naming a loopback missing from LOOPBACK_INTERFACE

BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_PORT.desc: Source a BMP session from an existing port

BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_PORT_MISS.desc: Reject a BMP source interface naming a port missing from PORT

BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_INTERNAL_.desc: Reject a BMP source interface on an internal port, even one in PORT
eStr: An internal port cannot source a BMP session

BMP_COLLECTOR_SOURCE_INTERFACE_MGMT_PORT.desc: Source a BMP session from eth0 with no MGMT_PORT row, as when ZTP brings eth0 up on DHCP
